title: Diarylethylamines / other non-ACH dissociatives
disclaimer: Fictional game catalog research. Unitless 0-100 inferences from public reports. Not a manual. No recipes. No how-to-take. No milligram instructions. No opioids. Pleasure and compulsiveness are independent axes. Families must stay separate.

alias_validations.label: MXP
alias_validations.note: One molecule. 3-MXP and 4-MXP are positional isomers and separate thin IDs.

alias_validations.label: DPH
alias_validations.note: Collision with diphenhydramine. Do not print DPH on a street sign.

punchiest_one_liners: They printed MXE on the hope.
Thirty seconds. Then the next balloon.
Corner-store disso. The plateaus are a personality test.
Silk sheet, not a blanket. Pack a week.
gaps: No head-to-head human study of ephenidine vs diphenidine vs MXP.
MXP horny-comedown / gram-day binges are loud and n-small.
Diphenidine deaths are almost all poly.
Fluorolintane DAT>NMDA is a paper; street feel is one thread.
Isophenidine 2022 report is high quality and tiny n. Do not clone ephenidine scores.
3-MXP theoretically hotter NMDA than 2-MXP with almost no trip reports.
DXO standalone may never have been a real aisle.
Memantine bladder/mania at greedy amounts is analogy plus a few posts.
MK-801 human n is tiny; Olney-lesion talk contaminates NPC fear.
Lefetamine old analgesic opioid-adjacent use must not become a downer SKU.
Later ortho-halo / N-alkyl diaryl stamps will keep arriving; do not auto-clone scores.

families.era: 2013-2016 legal-ket pivot after UK arylcyclohexylamine ban
slider_notes: Ephenidine is the enjoyment/euphoria high. MXP is the compulsiveness high. Diphenidine is the vape-rush maybe.
MXP flopped as an MXE replacement. Do not average the flop into low compulsiveness.
DXM is polarized. Do not average never-again into low euphoria.
DXO is the NMDA metabolite, not a Flask brick.
Nitrous compulsiveness is a session vacuum. Rush is the whole SKU.
Memantine recreational evidence is real. Duration kills redose. Amantadine is a shrug.
MK-801 is a horror story, not a SKU. Lanicemine and remacemide are clinical diaryls with no rec chorus.

agents.name: diphenidine

feel.headline: Legal ket that lies.

rush.note: Lives in the vape myth, not the swallow.

euphoria.note: Some warm-numb; many blank/dark. WHO: can be unpleasant.

enjoyment.note: Polarizing. Steep and dumb vs underrated walkaround.

compulsiveness.note: Vape redose. Another hit because the last one was confusing.

reinforcement.note: Some old heads still ask. Majority moved on.

paranoia.note: Agitation in tox series, usually poly.

agents.one_liner: Legal ket that lies.
agents.feel_text: Steep, dumb, long. Oral is a slow blank. Vape is the rumor people actually chase. Geometry dark vs ket. Can turn dysphoric with no warning.
agents.npc_line: Legal ket that lies.
gaps: Solo-vs-poly tox is a mess.
Vape-vs-oral feel is forum weather.
DPH tag collides with diphenhydramine.

agents.name: ephenidine

feel.headline: A kidnapping, not a hole.

rush.note: Melt, not a slam. Vape rumored harsher.

euphoria.note: Warmer and more recreational than diphenidine/MXP in forum consensus.

enjoyment.note: The diaryl people remember. Cosmic, forced, still glad.

compulsiveness.note: PW lists redose; duration argues with you.

paranoia.note: Less dark than diphenidine in chatter.

aftereffects.note: Long residual. Still somebody else's evening.

psychosis_concern.note: Forced/cosmic; combo multi-day insanity reports exist.

sleep.note: Hard to sleep while still kidnapped.

agents.one_liner: Not a hole. A kidnapping.
agents.feel_text: Warm, psychedelic, waves, time theft. Hole exists if you commit. Residual is the tax. Best enjoyment on the diaryl shelf.
agents.npc_line: Not a hole. A kidnapping.
gaps: Almost no clinical tox of its own.
Vape vs oral n is thin.

agents.name: MXP

feel.headline: They printed MXE on the hope.

rush.note: Faster if vaped. Still not MXE.

euphoria.note: Can hug. Can also be empty stoned. Afterglow sometimes the best hour.

enjoyment.note: Flop vs the MXE stamp. Some fans of the horny-stoned night.

compulsiveness.note: Gram-day binges, vape redose, withdrawal case. Fiend independent of the flop.

reinforcement.note: Comes back because the bag is there, not because it was MXE.

paranoia.note: ED confusion / agitation stories, often poly.

aftereffects.note: Long confusing residual; afterglow can be liked.

cardiovascular.note: Hypertension, tachycardia, nystagmus in case reports.

agents.one_liner: They printed MXE on the hope.
agents.feel_text: Sold as the MXE replacement. Soft DXM-ish buzz, empty/clear brochure cognition, then horny-stupid comedown in some reports. Compulsive. Not MXE.
agents.npc_line: They printed MXE on the hope.
gaps: 2 vs 3 vs 4-MXP bags were not a street chorus.
Horny-comedown n is small and loud.

agents.name: fluorolintane

feel.headline: Stim until it isn't. One bottle.

compulsiveness.note: DAT-heavy on paper. No binge chorus.

aftereffects.note: Shorter than piperidine diaryls in the one thread.

agents.one_liner: Stim until it isn't. One bottle.
agents.feel_text: Pyrrolidine plus ortho-fluoro. Low stim, high disso. DAT often hotter than NMDA in the 2019 paper. WEDINOS zero. One bottle.
agents.npc_line: One bottle. It couldn't decide if it was flakka or ket.
gaps: n is a rounding error.
Do not auto-clone pyro compulsiveness from DAT affinity.

agents.name: isophenidine

feel.headline: Ephenidine's cousin almost nobody met.

compulsiveness.note: Too rare to fiend. Week-long cross-tolerance.

agents.one_liner: Ephenidine's cousin almost nobody met.
agents.feel_text: Ephenidine-shaped, softer, visual, functional in the 2022 custom-synth report. Early-2010s vendor rumor then silence. Not IPPH.
agents.npc_line: They put an isopropyl on it and forgot to tell the street.
gaps: Do not clone ephenidine scores. n is tiny.

agents.name: lefetamine

feel.headline: Grandpa of the shelf. Stim with a codeine rumor.

agents.one_liner: That's the parent. It doesn't hole. It fidgets.
agents.feel_text: 1950s-80s analgesic with stimulant plus codeine-rumor body. UK Class B stim. The diaryl NPS wall is a lefetamine-derivative story. Not a k-hole SKU.
agents.npc_line: That's the parent. It doesn't hole. It fidgets.
gaps: Must not become a downer SKU. Weak old opioid-adjacent analgesic chatter stays lore.

agents.name: 3-MXP

feel.headline: The hotter isomer nobody wrote about.

agents.one_liner: The hotter isomer nobody wrote about.
agents.feel_text: WHO 2-MXP review NMDA rank: 3-MXP > 2-MXP > 4-MXP. Denmark controlled the trio. Human nights: basically zero.
agents.npc_line: They scheduled the ghost isomer.
gaps: Theoretically hotter NMDA than the actual product. Still not a bag people talk about.

feel.headline: Para-methoxy. Weaker on paper. Silent in kitchens.

agents.one_liner: Para-methoxy. Weaker on paper. Silent in kitchens.
agents.feel_text: Lowest NMDA of the MXP isomers in the WHO rank. No trip-report wall.
agents.npc_line: The quiet isomer.

agents.name: DXM

feel.headline: Corner-store disso. The plateaus are a personality test.

rush.note: Oral crawl. The rush does not exist.

euphoria.note: Music/float for the third who stay. Do not average haters into a 20.

enjoyment.note: Polarized. Fans are fans. Dirty mystical vs never-again.

compulsiveness.note: Cheap. Daily robos exist. Plateau chasing.

psychosis_concern.note: Sigma/serotonin wacky on top of NMDA.

agents.one_liner: Corner-store disso. The plateaus are a personality test.
agents.feel_text: OTC cough disso. Plat 1 music-drunk, plat 2 stoned flange, plat 3 thinking-damage, plat 4 unhook. Body-load tax. Not Flask.
agents.npc_line: Corner-store disso. Not Flask.
gaps: HBr vs polistirex vs freebase are formulations, not extra SKUs.
No extraction SOP in this catalog.

agents.name: dextrorphan

feel.headline: DXM after it took a shower.

euphoria.note: More stoned, less sparkle than parent DXM.

enjoyment.note: Cleaner hole in the FAQ. Few standalone nights.

paranoia.note: Less sigma-crazy than DXM on paper.

psychosis_concern.note: Weaker psychotomimetic vs DXM in the FAQ split.

agents.one_liner: DXM after it took a shower. Still cough syrup's kid.
agents.feel_text: Main NMDA metabolite of DXM. Stronger stoning/dissociation, weaker sigma fireworks. Most DXM nights are a blend. Not a Flask brick.
agents.npc_line: That's the hole inside the syrup. You don't get it in a bag.
gaps: Almost no modern RC-era DXO vendor chorus.

agents.name: nitrous oxide

feel.headline: Thirty seconds. Then the next balloon.

enjoyment.note: High in the room. Empty on the walk home.

compulsiveness.note: Session vacuum. Charger after charger. Hated binges still score high.

reinforcement.note: Easy to buy. Life-plot only if B12 is already writing the ending.

agents.one_liner: Thirty seconds. Then the next balloon.
agents.feel_text: Club crate. Whoosh, wah-wah, laugh, gone. Session-fiend legendary. Mixes with every other disso like a multiplier.
agents.npc_line: Club crate, not a wall.
gaps: B12 timeline vs session-fiend is a harm flag, not a feel score.

agents.name: xenon

feel.headline: Nitrous for people with a trust fund.

agents.one_liner: Nitrous for people with a trust fund.
agents.feel_text: NMDA noble gas. Medical anesthetic. Recreational n is tiny and expensive. Not a v1 brick.
agents.npc_line: He paid for a balloon that isn't a balloon.

agents.name: memantine

feel.headline: Silk sheet, not a blanket. Pack a week.

rush.note: Hours. Redose is how you book Thursday.

euphoria.note: Mood-lift, music, not a roll. Less warm than DXM.

enjoyment.note: Functional weird. Engineer-brain subset likes it.

compulsiveness.note: Duration kills redose. Independent of enjoyment.

reinforcement.note: Some keep coming back. Not a binge drug.

agents.one_liner: Silk sheet, not a blanket. Pack a week.
agents.feel_text: Diverted Alzheimer's NMDA. Slow, multi-day, functional, less wacky than DXM. Can hole if greedy, then you live there. Recreational evidence is real.
agents.npc_line: That's not a night. That's a weather front.
gaps: Bladder/mania at greedy amounts is analogy plus a few posts.
